scope: Corollary 2.7 (Sparsity) of the manuscript “A finite Smith–Toda complex V(4) at the prime 1009” (preprints/A-finite-Smith-Toda-complex-V4-at-the-prime-1009-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a9cf0165a9ea2949), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If BP∗Z is concentrated in internal degrees divisible by q, then all pages of its Adams–Novikov spectral sequence have that same internal sparsity. Every possibly nonzero positive differential has length r = qk + 1 for an integer k ≥ 1. In weight notation it changes (s, w) to (s + qk + 1, w + k). In particular, a primitive coefficient of weight un in filtration zero can have only targets (s, w) = (qk + 1, un + k), k ≥ 1. (2.6)
